title: triticum dicoccum subsp. dicoccoides
intro: Triticum dicoccum subsp. dicoccoides, commonly known as wild einkorn, is an ancient type of wheat that is native to the mountainous regions of the Near East. This plant is known for its nutritional and medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of wild einkorn may be attributed to its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be mediated by bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and dietary fiber. The bioactive constituents of wild einkorn have been shown to have prebiotic effects, supporting the growth of beneficial gut bacteria and promoting overall gut health.
